import re

def parse_demo(text, n, dim):
    match=re.search(rf'Demo pair {n} input \({dim}x{dim}\):\n(.*?)\nDemo pair {n} output \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n(.*?)(?:\n\nSame instance|\Z)', text, re.S)
    assert match, 'no match'
    ins=[[int(x) for x in line.split()] for line in match.group(1).splitlines()]
    out=[[int(x) for x in line.split()] for line in match.group(4).splitlines()]
    return ins,out
# retrieve message with demo 2
